verdict.rationale: Otter's own docs say it delivers briefing documents before a meeting that contain prior discussions, action items, and updates, which covers both the past-meeting context and the brief of open threads before the call. Organizing meetings by client and natural-language search across past calls reinforce surfacing prior context. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that briefs are matched to the same attendees, detail on how the brief is generated and delivered, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I walk into each meeting prepped — the tool surfaces past meetings with the same people and a brief of open threads before the call

citations.quote: Have briefing documents delivered before your meeting with all the prior discussions, action items, and updates you need.
Keep meetings and notes organized by client, opportunity, or topic to easily revisit key highlights and follow-ups.
Find key insights from past calls, documents, and more using natural-language.
